facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Trinity (2,890 ft) and Lyman Lake (5,990 ft) between 7 days earlier and 1 day later this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), May 8 (2024), May 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Lyman Lake
evidence.detail: left June 13; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 25 (2024), June 12 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the second highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Lyman Lake (5,990 ft) and the lowest at Trinity (2,890 ft).

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: 20.1 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 26.9 in (2023), 21.3 in (2024), 26.3 in (2025)

evidence.name: Lyman Lake
evidence.detail: 48.8 in on April 4; earlier seasons: 52.8 in (2023), 37.7 in (2024), 42.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between June 4 and August 6, carried from the melt-out date at Lyman Lake (5,990 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Lyman Lake
evidence.detail: melted out June 13, 1,291 ft below the pass; points to June 4 to August 6
